carpet.rule.comparatorGetsRealTime.name: Comparator Retrieves UTC Time
carpet.rule.comparatorGetsRealTime.desc: When enabled, comparators can obtain hexadecimal digits (corresponding to seconds) of UTC time from clock-containing item frames, determined by the clock's rotation angle
carpet.rule.comparatorGetsRealTimeHigh32: Comparator Retrieves UTC Time High 32-bit Block
When UTC time retrieval is enabled, comparators will obtain corresponding hexadecimal digits from the high 32 bits of UTC time when detecting clock item frames through this specific block type
carpet.rule.anvilKeepHigherLevels.name: Anvil Keeps Higher Levels
carpet.rule.anvilKeepHigherLevels.desc: Default (off): the anvil enchantment level cap clamps the merged level, even if the material level or the level already on the item is higher. Enable so the anvil keeps levels that are higher than the cap, whether on the item or in the material.
carpet.rule.disableAnvilPunishment.name: Disable anvil punishment
carpet.rule.fakePlayerExperienceDuplicat: Fixes the issue where Carpet mod's fake players do not clear experience points upon death. This rule addresses the experience duplication exploit.
carpet.rule.survivalAnvilLimit.name: Survival Anvil Limit
carpet.rule.survivalAnvilLimit.desc: Modify anvil "Too Expensive" limit in survival, set as negative value to unlock all limit
carpet.rule.modifyUnbreakingFunction.des: Modify Unbreaking enchantment function magnification from "n + 1" to "n + 1 + n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) / 24"
carpet.rule.commandHead.name: Head Command Switch
carpet.rule.commandHead.desc:
When enabled, allows non-operator players to use /head command (to obtain their own player head)
/head command usage:
• When holding a blank skull: Converts it to your player head
• When holding your player head: Converts it back to a blank skull
• Other cases: Returns an error
carpet.rule.furnaceClear.name: Furnace Cleaner
carpet.rule.furnaceClear.desc: When enabled, automatically processes items when the furnace input slot is clogged
carpet.rule.furnaceClearMode.name: Furnace Cleaner Processing Mode
carpet.rule.furnaceClearMode.desc:
Select how to handle furnace input:
• direct_destroy: Destroy input items immediately
• direct_pass: Pass items to output slot immediately
• smelt_destroy: Destroy after normal smelting cycle
• smelt_pass: Pass to output after normal smelting cycle
carpet.rule.loveGhastling.name: LoveGhastling Level
carpet.rule.loveGhastling.desc: LoveGhastling level. 0 keeps vanilla behavior unchanged. When set to 1, dried ghasts are removed from piglin barter loot. When set to -1, dried ghasts become edible.
carpet.rule.phantomSpawnMonsterCapped.de: When enabled, phantom spawning is limited by global and local monster mob caps. Phantoms only spawn for a player while the monster population stays below the configured limits.
carpet.rule.phantomSpawnMonsterCappedGlo: Phantom Spawn Monster Capped Global Extra
Extra allowance added to the global monster mob cap for phantom spawning. Phantoms may still spawn while the global monster count stays below (vanilla global cap + this value).
carpet.rule.phantomSpawnMonsterCappedLoc: Phantom Spawn Monster Capped Local Extra

Extra allowance added to the vanilla per-player local monster cap for phantom spawning. A phantom only spawns for a player while that player's local monster count stays below (vanilla local cap + this value).
carpet.rule.phantomsCountAsMonster.name: Phantoms Count As Monster
carpet.rule.phantomsCountAsMonster.desc: Whether phantoms are counted in the monster (MONSTER) mob category. Disable to move phantoms to the MISC category so they no longer count toward monster mob caps (including the phantomSpawnMonsterCapped limits). Default keeps vanilla behavior.
carpet.rule.playerListUsesUUID.name: Player Lists Use UUID
carpet.rule.playerListUsesUUID.desc: When enabled (default), whitelist/blacklist entries are matched by player UUID. Disable to match by player name instead.
carpet.rule.playerListIgnoreCase.name: Player List Ignores Case
carpet.rule.playerListIgnoreCase.desc: When enabled (default), player name lookups ignore letter case. Disable to make them case-sensitive.
carpet.lpc.validator.playerListRulesWarn: Changing player list matching rules may cause instability. A server restart is recommended.
carpet.rule.nonWhitelistedPlayerGameType: Game mode applied to non-whitelisted players when they join, instead of kicking them. REJECT (default) keeps vanilla behavior and kicks non-whitelisted players. Only takes effect when the whitelist is on with enforce-whitelist enabled.
carpet.rule.whitelistPlayerGameType.name: Whitelisted Player Game Mode
carpet.rule.whitelistPlayerGameType.desc: Game mode applied to whitelisted players when they join the server. UNSET (default) leaves their game mode unchanged. Only applies to whitelisted players when the whitelist is on; with the whitelist off it applies to every player.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersA: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from attacking (breaking) blocks.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersI: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from interacting with blocks.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersA: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from attacking entities.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersI: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from interacting with entities.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersM: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from moving items in containers.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersD: Non-Whitelisted Cannot Drop Or Pick Items
When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from dropping or picking up items.
carpet.rule.rejectNonWhitelistedPlayersE: When enabled, non-whitelisted players are prevented from editing signs.
carpet.lpc.whitelist.notWhitelisted: You are not on the whitelist yet, so you cannot do this.
